Subject: Post-demo: deployment mode qualification & next steps

Hi Alice — great to meet you and the team on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary from our demo
- Primary goal: lower-latency patient-facing assistant for triage + internal search.
- Data: PHI in scope (clinical notes + patient metadata).
- Traffic shape: daytime peak traffic, cyclical (you mentioned high mornings).

Open questions we flagged
1) Deployment mode preference: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity), or Private VPC/on-prem (PHI + stricter controls).
2) Expected scale: daily tokens, peak requests/sec, average tokens per request.
3) Latency SLOs and any hard limits for critical flows.
4) Procurement/contract timing and any minimum commit expectations.

Next steps (proposed)
- Can you confirm the ballpark numbers for tokens/day and peak RPS? That will determine whether Dedicated reserved capacity or Hosted per-token is more economical.
- We’ll produce a short cost-model (hosted per-token vs. dedicated reserved vs. private VPC) and share examples.
- Schedule a deep-dive with Marissa (SE) to go over security matrix and deployment checklist — propose Thurs 2/12 or Mon 2/16.

Attached: deployment_modes_one_pager.pdf (overview of Hosted/Dedicated/Private).

Thanks — I’ll draft a high-level pricing comparison once you confirm the traffic numbers.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Aditya — thanks for the recap and the demo. A few numbers from our side to help the modelling:

- Expected production: ~1.5M tokens/day (across all features)
- Peak: ~35-45 req/s during business hours (US Eastern)
- Average tokens per response: ~18 tokens
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for user-facing flows
- Data residency/security: PHI; we prefer Private VPC but are open to Dedicated if it meets our audit controls (SOC 2 + KMS/HSM support).
- Procurement: looking to evaluate pricing this month; pilot start in Apr 2026.

Attached is a short requirements sheet that the security/procurement team asked me to include. Please confirm whether you need full traffic traces or sample logs to build the model.

Best,

Thanks for the numbers — super helpful. Based on the inputs (1.5M tokens/day, peak ~40 RPS, avg ~18 tokens/response, PHI), here are rough ballpark cost comparisons and assumptions. These are intentionally high-level — Marissa will run a detailed model once we have traces.

Assumptions
- 1.5M tokens/day -> ~45M tokens/month (30-day month)
- Avg tokens/request = 18 -> ~2.5M requests/month
- Peak concurrency: 40 RPS -> drives latency and sizing for Dedicated/Private

Option A - Hosted API (per-token pricing)
- Unit: $0.0006 / token (example tier) -> 45M tokens/month * $0.0006 = $27,000 / month
- Pros: fastest onboarding, no infra ops; Cons: higher marginal cost at scale, VPC options limited for PHI without Private plan

Option B - Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit)
- Example sizing that meets p95 <200ms at 40 RPS: 4 x GPU nodes (A100-equivalent) with autoscale buffer
- Estimated monthly commit: $18,000- $25,000 / month (reserved) + usage overage pricing
- Pros: better unit economics at sustained load, private tenancy; Cons: commit required, slower spin-up for spikes

Option C - Private VPC / On-prem
- One-time onboarding & integration fee: $25k- $50k (security packaging, KMS/HSM integration, deployment)
- Ongoing platform fee + infra (depends on customer cloud or on-prem costs) - ballpark similar to Dedicated once steady state
- Pros: best for PHI/regulatory needs and strict network controls; Cons: higher upfront, longer procurement cycle

Next steps
- Marissa (cc'd) will prepare a detailed cost model and a comparison sheet (hosted vs dedicated vs private) - helpful to get a 7-14 day traffic sample if available.
- Can you confirm: 1) monthly token total (45M assumed) and 2) any hard budget targets for commit size? That lets us align Dedicated proposals to procurement thresholds.

Links: HubSpot deal and draft price sheet -> https://hubspot.redwood.example.com/deal/ACME-HEALTH-2245
Attachment: redwood_pricing_teaser.pdf (ballpark commitment tiers & examples).

Thanks - happy to jump on a pricing call tomorrow if helpful.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_pricing_teaser.pdf, 48KB)
